items.title: Your Obsidian Web Clipper Isn't Broken. Claude.ai Just Can't Be Clipped
items.description: Your Obsidian Web Clipper isn't broken — a Claude chat physically can't be clipped. Claude only keeps the messages near your screen loaded and drops the rest as you scroll, so there's no moment where the whole conversation exists on the page to grab. You get half a note, every time. Here's why it happens, and the one command I use now to get the whole thing into my vault — styled so it reads like the conversation, not a wall of text. 🔗 THE COMMAND, SKILL, SCRIPT + CSS https://ko-fi.com/s/58e9b6f816 💬 Don't want the command? The share link and the Claude data export are free and work today — I show both in the video. items.title: Obsidian Properties | Skip This and You'll Regret It (Bases, Web Clipper & AI)
items.description: 📦 OBSIDIAN VAULTS 🔗 Free Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/33678f10a7 (Free) 🔗 Pro Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/c8e544e005 (Donation) 🔗 Ultimate Vault: https://ko-fi.com/s/cf438d571d 🔗 Ko-Fi Shop: https://ko-fi.com/motion2082/shop 🤖 OBSIDIAN AI TOOLS ($7/month) 🔗 https://obsidianaitools.com/ VIDEO DESCRIPTION Two years ago I made a video about YAML properties, and it's still one of the most watched videos on this channel. But Obsidian Bases changed everything — properties are now what power every base in your vault, and they're more important than ever. In this video I show you the bases running my real vault (my Ideas base, my YouTube library and a timeline of every note I create), how the Obsidian Web Clipper fills in properties for you, and the mistake I made four years ago that left hundreds of notes with no metadata — plus how I fix those old notes with AI in minutes instead of weeks. If you're new to Obsidian, stick around for the beginner tutorial at the end: building an ideas template with YAML properties and wiring it to QuickAdd, so every new note starts with the right metadata. ⏱️ CHAPTERS 00:00 — Intro - Why Properties matter 00:22 — The Ideas Base: Why Properties Matter 02:24 — The YouTube Vault Base 04:51 — Obsidian Web Clipper: Properties Filled For You 06:36 — Video Notes with Media Extended 07:08 — Note Retrieval Timeline: Everything In One Place 08:00 — The Mistake I Made Four Years Ago 09:10 — Fixing Old Notes with AI 10:48 — Building an Ideas Template (Beginner Tutorial) 12:30 — Every Property Type Explained 15:29 — QuickAdd Template Choice Setup 18:05 — Outro 🎬 RELATED VIDEOS 🔗 The original YAML Properties video (2024): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=diZ4AFh-ZNI 🔗 Hiding Annoying YAML Properties: https://youtu.be/cigqRZUY7YA 🔗 Obsidian Web Clipper + AI: https://youtu.be/DS75Vw4IyoA 🔌 PLUGINS SHOWN Obsidian Web Clipper (browser extension): https://obsidian.md/clipper QuickAdd, Commander, Media Extended, Folder Notes — all in the community plugin store 📝 OBSIDIAN Properties Documentation 🔗 https://obsidian.md/help/properties ☕ Buy me a Coffee https://ko-fi.com/motion2082 #Obsidian #ObsidianBases #YAMLproperties #NoteTaking #PKM #ObsidianWebClipper

items.title: Find Every AI Note in Obsidian Instantly | Recently Added Plugin
items.description: 📦 OBSIDIAN VAULTS 🔗 Free Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/33678f10a7 (Free) 🔗 Pro Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/c8e544e005 (Donation) 🔗 Ultimate Vault: https://ko-fi.com/s/cf438d571d 🔗 Ko-Fi Shop :https://ko-fi.com/motion2082/shop 🤖 OBSIDIAN AI TOOLS ($7/month) 🔗 https://obsidianaitools.com/ 🤖 N8N Automations 🔗 https://hostinger.com/pauld (10% Off existing plans) 🔗 https://ko-fi.com/s/77cb42af2e (Self Host your own n8n for Free) ⏱️ CHAPTERS 00:00 — Intro 00:49 - What I tried first 02:23 - The Fix — Recently Added Demo 05:55 - Installing the Recently Added Plugin 07:03 — Outro 🔌 GET THE PLUGIN 🔗 Recently Added (GitHub): https://github.com/motion2082/recently-added-obsidian Install the BRAT plugin from Obsidian Community Plugins Open BRAT settings → Add Beta Plugin Enter: https://github.com/motion2082/recently-added-obsidian Enable the plugin in Settings → Community Plugins VIDEO DESCRIPTION If you use AI or n8n to automate notes into Obsidian, you've probably lost track of where those files get created. For me, that's usually when I distill an AI conversation through n8n, or when Claude Code drops a note straight into my vault while I'm working. Either way, a note shows up somewhere, and I'm stuck trying to remember where the automation put it. So I built a plugin called Recently Added to give me a quick snapshot of those notes the second they land. That's what we're getting into today. Build an automated Obsidian AI workflow to capture, process, and organise your notes without the manual effort of standard clipping. This system uses N8N automation to turn raw conversations and web clips into structured insights. If you struggle with information overload or maintaining a messy Obsidian vault, this setup provides a repeatable process for capturing value from your digital interactions. You will learn how to connect external AI tools directly to your note-taking environment for better reflection and retrieval. We examine the practical pros and cons of using Claude Code and various AI-driven automations within your daily routine. By integrating these tools, you move beyond simple note-taking and start building a functional personal knowledge management system. This approach is ideal for anyone looking to refine their Obsidian AI workflow while keeping their data organised and accessible. Subscribe for weekly personal knowledge management breakdowns, and let me know in the comments if you prefer N8N or native plugins for your automation setup. ☕ Buy me a Coffee https://ko-fi.com/motion2082 #Obsidian, #PKM, #AITools, #N8N, #automationsystem

items.title: My Obsidian Starter Vault Pro — What's New in 2026 (Bases, Web Clipper and AI Tools)
items.description: This is my Obsidian Starter Vault Pro. Since releasing it back in 2024, it's sold over 500 copies on Ko-fi — and the free Starter Kit has been downloaded more than 6,000 times. items.title: My Claude Code Review System I Actually Use
items.description: VIDEO DESCRIPTION I built a Cycles and Reviews system two years ago and barely touched it — not because it was broken, because I kept forgetting. So I built /auto-reflect: a custom AI command that automatically creates my weekly, monthly, and quarterly reflections and reviews inside Obsidian. Reminders plugin handles the scheduling. All I maintain is my daily journal. CHAPTERS 00:00 — Intro: The problem: I never do my reviews 00:12 - Automating my Cycles and Reviews 00:53 — Reflect and Review: three notes, automatically created 01:57 — How the auto-reflect command works 02:39 — Running it with Claudian 04:38 - Reminders plugin firing after automation 06:26 — Reminders plugin: Never forget a reflection or review 07:29 — Monthly review automated demo 09:48 - How I Access my Reflect and Review Reminders 10:52 - n8n self hosting options 11:02 - n8n option hands off automations 11:17 - How my Cycles and Reviews System works now 12:34 — How to Get the Auto Reflect Command 12:49 - Outro HELPFUL LINKS 🔗 Ultimate Vault: https://ko-fi.com/s/cf438d571d 🔗 Obsidian Life OS Vault: https://ko-fi.com/s/ada1cb7720 🔗 Obsidian AI Tools ($7 month): https://obsidianaitools.com/ - Install AI Tools with BRAT: https://github.com/UltimateAI-org/aitoolsforobsidian 🔗 Claudian - https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/realclaudian 🔗 Turn AI Conversations into Permanent Notes: https://youtu.be/p13zoerJRq4 🔗 Self Host n8n Docker: https://ko-fi.com/s/77cb42af2e 🔗 Self Host n8n Hostinger: https://hostinger.com/pauld (extra 10% off existing discounts) ☕ Buy me a Coffee https://ko-fi.com/motion2082

items.title: Obsidian AI Plugin Had a Dependency Problem — Here's What Changed
items.description: Obsidian Starter Vault Download Free Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/33678f10a7 (Free) Pro Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/c8e544e005 (Donation) Ultimate Vault: https://ko-fi.com/s/cf438d571d Agent and SKills Vault: https://ko-fi.com/s/3b90e4283e Ko-Fi Shop :https://ko-fi.com/motion2082/shop Obsidian AI Tools ($7 month) https://obsidianaitools.com/ Install AI Tools with BRAT https://github.com/UltimateAI-org/aitoolsforobsidian Become a Vault Explorer https://ko-fi.com/motion2082/tiers https://paulsvaultmembers.com/#join CHAPTERS 00:00 — Intro 00:20 - AI Tools - What's New in v0.9.0 03:22 - Agent Client Protocol - What Changed and Why? 04:27 — Outro VIDEO DESCRIPTION The core package my Obsidian AI Tools plugin depended on was deprecated. Not broken — deprecated. There's a difference. And that difference turned out to be genuinely good news. In this video I'm showing you what changed in v0.9.0, why the ACP migration happened, and what it means for your setup. What's new in v0.9.0: System Status panel — node, npm, Claude Agent and Gemini CLI at a glance One-click updates — no more running npm commands manually Developer Diagnostics — error logging for when things go wrong Front-end update detection — plugin tells you when it's out of date Why it changed: The old Zed Industries packages were replaced by the official Agent Client Protocol organisation. ACP is now a cross-IDE standard — JetBrains, Cursor, VS Code. This wasn't housekeeping. The ecosystem grew up. 🔗 AI Tools inside Obsidian - Which one is right for you? https://youtu.be/nfD5tGvNYAA 🔗 Previous video — Building AI Tools for Obsidian - Claude Code Integration https://youtu.be/a0k8wh69PjM?si=_ueoYhZXr_wlLGme 🔗 NPM Agent Client Protocol SDK https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentclientprotocol/sdk // Buy me a Coffee https://ko-fi.com/motion2082
